website.title: Let’s build your next website.
website.summary: A first website, a rebuild or a better path from followers to customers. Tell David what your business needs; we’ll talk through the scope, timing and cost before you commit.
website.messageLabel: What are you looking to build or improve?
website.placeholder: What does your business do, where are your customers, and what should the website help them do? Budget and launch date are helpful if you know them.
website.assurance: First 30 minutes free. No obligation. A written scope before paid work.

faq.question: What happens after I send my brief?
faq.answer: David reviews your project and replies using the contact details you provide. We discuss what the site needs to do, your timing and your budget. The first 30 minutes are free; any paid work starts with an agreed written scope and price.

faq.question: Do I need a website, a finished brief or a set budget?
faq.answer: No. Start with your business and what you want customers to do. A website or social profile helps if you have one. Share a budget range or target date if known; we can discuss the options together.

faq.question: Can we keep our booking system and existing accounts?
faq.answer: We review your current tools before recommending changes. Your scope identifies what stays, what connects to the website and any separate provider costs. Keep passwords and private customer information out of this form.

support.title: Get your day moving again.
support.summary: Tell us what stopped working, when it started, and who is affected. We’ll review the issue and confirm what help we can offer.
support.placeholder: For example: our Wi-Fi drops, the register is unreliable, or we cannot get into an account.

consulting.title: Check the plan before you spend.
consulting.summary: Share the quote, software bill, or decision you are weighing. We’ll look at what your business needs and explain the options.
consulting.placeholder: For example: we have two tools that do the same job, a vendor sent a quote, or we need to choose booking software.

systems.title: Make the repeat work easier.
systems.summary: Describe one task that gets copied, delayed, or lost between tools. We’ll check whether the tools you have can do the job before proposing a build.
systems.placeholder: For example: staff type each order twice, approvals get lost in messages, or a weekly report takes hours to put together.

general.title: Start with what is getting in the way.
general.summary: A website link, an error message, or a few lines about the business are enough to start. We’ll take a free first look and explain what we can help with.
general.messageLabel: What would you like to improve or fix?
general.placeholder: For example: We have no website yet and customers find us on Instagram, we need online booking, or a tool is slowing us down.
